The packaged self-contained checker separately verifies 190 finite group-generated cases over F2, with the finite/infinite distinction disclosed.

value.rationale: The natural family of all subgroup geometric fixed spaces is completely classified. Fixed sets can be empty, disconnected, and have independently varying first- and second-homology wedge summands controlled by orbit sizes 1,2,3. These isotropy data are not determined by the previously known ordinary sphere wedge and are useful for distinguishing symmetry types and checking equivariant constructions; the theorem has a uniform proof rather than an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
